text: Bitcoin is outpacing Ethereum with a stronger 24-hour gain (+1.6% vs +0.8%), signaling modest flight-to-safety behavior among traders despite extreme fear sentiment. The Fear & Greed index at 25 with deteriorating momentum suggests market participants remain deeply risk-averse, yet the $56B daily volume and stable Bitcoin dominance at 56.4% indicate enough liquidity to prevent panic selling. Altcoins are moving sideways relative to Bitcoin, typical of periods when sentiment is depressed but not in freefall.
